Commentary.Commentary: We are set for the second essay! The players of Bangladesh have made their way out in the middle. Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam are at the crease! Mahedi Hasan to start with the ball.
...THE RUN CHASE...

Right then! Pakistan need just 109 runs to win the match and seal the series! It appears to be a comfortable chase for them but Bangladesh do possess a fine bowling attack which can trouble any batting line-up. We are in for another interesting chase which is set to begin shortly.

Pakistan were right on the money from the word go and their bowlers executed the plans to perfection. Shaheen Afridi struck in the very first over and he was backed up well by Mohammad Wasim. The spinners did their job nicely as they hardly gave away any freebies to Bangladesh's batters and kept them in check. Shadab Khan was brilliant yet again as he gave away just 22 runs from his 4 overs and picked up two crucial wickets, not to forget that terrific catch off his own bowling to remove the set batsman, Najmul Hossain Shanto. Mohammad Nawaz and Haris Rauf also got into the wickets column and all in all, it was a fine bowling performance from the visitors.

After opting to bat, Bangladesh once again lost their openers early. Najmul Hossain Shanto and Afif Hossain then staged a comeback with their spirited partnership but just as they were looking to up the ante, Afif Hossain perished by playing a needless shot. Mahmudullah too fell cheaply and once Najmul was dismissed, Bangladesh's innings nosedived. No other batter managed to get in and score freely and as a result, the home side only managed to put up 108 runs on the board. There were a total of 57 dot balls in their innings and that quite sums up their story.

This has been yet another disappointing display of batting from the hosts and they have only themselves to blame for their poor show. The Pakistan bowlers were very clinical and disciplined with the ball in hand and Babar Azam and his men would have definitely taken this score at the start of the innings.

Rauf delivers it on a length around off at 92.2 mph, Taskin swings his bat at it and gets an inside edge. It goes past the stumps to short fine leg and they pick up a single. Bangladesh finish on a paltry score of 108/7.
Slower delivery, at 70.6 mph, a touch short and around off, Aminul pulls it down to long on for a run.
A 90 mph delivery again, it's on a length around off, Aminul walks across the stumps with his attempted paddle shot but fails to connect.
A full toss around off at 90.7 mph, Taskin hangs deep inside the crease and hammers it down to mid off. The fielder is up inside the ring and stops the ball. A single is taken.
Sharp delivery, at 90.5 mph and on middle, Islam knocks it down to long on for a run.
Play and a miss! Rauf keeps it full and just outside off, Aminul steps back to give himself room but ends up chasing and missing.
Haris Rauf (2-0-9-1) comes back to bowl the last over of the innings.

Chance of a run out! Very full and on middle, Taskin has his bat down in time as he digs it out on the leg side. He comes out of the crease, in search of a run but is sent back. Shaheen is quick to reach the ball, he has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Shortish and around off, it's ramped down to third man for a run.

NOT OUT! Taskin is safe. Shaheen Afridi speeds in from over the wicket for the left-hander and spears in a very full ball around middle and leg, it's drifting down in the air. Taskin fails to flick and is hit on the back leg. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Shaheen convinces his skipper to take the DRS. The replays roll in and the Ball Tracker shows that the impact is outside leg. Poor review. A leg bye is added to the total.
Taskin Ahmed has been struck on his pad and Babar Azam has opted for a review! The Ball Tracker confirms that the ball would have missed the leg stump by a mile and Pakistan lose another review!
Taskin Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Nurul departs and with that Bangladesh have lost their last recognized batsman. The slower one does the trick for Shaheen, he bowls it on a fuller length outside off at 78.2 mph, Nurul makes room for a big booming drive but the ball arrives late to take the outside edge. Mohammad Rizwan catches the ball and Bangladesh lose their seventh wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Shaheen Afridi

Commentary.Commentary: Shaheen switches to 'round the wicket and delivers a length ball on off, Aminul is stuck inside the crease trying to work it on the leg side. He gets a leading edge instead and it goes down to long off for a run.
Back of a length around off, Hasan plays late and close to his body as he glides it down through short third man for a run.
100 up! Quick through the air, full and around leg, Nurul fails to flick and it goes off his pads to point. They take a leg bye. 1 for 25 in Nawaz' four overs.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Bangladesh, they waited for an age to get one. Nawaz follows the batsman down the leg side with a short ball, Nurul finds it in his range and pulls it firmly to wide long on for a boundary. First boundary for the hosts after the 12th over.
Quicker one on middle, helped to square leg for a run.
Short again, around off, Nurul plays very late, almost off the keeper's gloves and taps it down towards short third man for one.
Flatter and shorter on off, Aminul gets back and punches it down to long on for a single.

Fires in a quicker delivery on middle and leg, Nurul tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. It goes off the leading edge to point and they scamper across for a single. A direct hit at the bowler's end would have made things interesting.
On a length around middle, at 89 mph, Nurul tucks it in front of square leg and retains strike with a single. Runs have dried up here for Bangladesh.
Shaheen attempts to follow a couple of slower deliveries with a pacy yorker but ends up bowling a full toss around off, Islam pushes it to mid off and takes a single.
Beaten again with the slower one. Back of a length, around off and cutting away at 79.3 mph, Aminul ends up pushing and missing inside the line.
Play and a miss! Slower one, at 79 mph, on a length and outside off, Aminul Islam is early into the drive and gets beaten all ends up.
Around off on a length, Islam taps it down to point. Shadab misfields but no run is taken.
Shaheen Afridi digs in a short delivery, well directed at the batsman, Aminul ducks at the last moment with his bat hanging like a periscope.
Shaheen Afridi (2-0-10-1) is back on.
Slower through the air, it's full and on middle, Aminul nudges it in the gap at mid-wicket and Nawaz runs after the ball. They take a single to close the over.
Flatter delivery, a bit short and around off, Aminul stays on the back foot and defends it back.
Quicker one, full and around off, Islam pushes it from the back foot to covers.
Aminul Islam walks out to bat now. A slight hold in play as Nurul Hasan has gone for a comfort break.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Nawaz gets his first wicket and Bangladesh continue to slip. Flighted delivery on middle, it lands and grips a touch as Mahedi advances down the track for a big shot. The ball though takes the bottom half of his bat and he ends up chipping an easy return catch to the bowler. Six down and Banglades have not posted even 100 runs on the board so far.
Flighted but too full on middle, Mahedi works it through square leg and picks up a couple of runs.

Appeal for a run out! Flatter delivery, around off, Nurul plays it down from the crease to point and they scamper across for a quick run. The fielder fires a throw to the keeper who takes the bails off. The appeal is made, it's referred upstairs but Mahedi is found to be safe in the replays.
Bowling change as Shadab Khan has bowled out. Mohammad Nawaz to bowl...
Length ball, jagging back in sharply from middle and leg. Mahedi Hasan looks to flick but he misses and gets hit high on his pad.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, outside off. Mahedi Hasan looks to poke at it but he misses as the ball zips past the outside edge.
Back of a length, around off. Nurul Hasan blocks it off the back foot and scampers through for a run.
Leg bye! Banged in short, around leg. Mahedi Hasan looks to pull but is late in his shot and gets hit on his body. The ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye.
Play and a miss! Good-length ball, outside off. Mahedi Hasan looks to push it through the cover region but he does not get any bat on it.
Back of a length, around off. Mahedi Hasan blocks it off the back foot.
Mohammad Wasim is back into the attack. 1 for 8 in his 2 overs so far.
A bit quicker, on a length, around off. Nurul Hasan pushes it back to the bowler. That ends an excellent spell of Shadab Khan. He finishes with figures of 4-0-22-2.
Flatter ball, outside off. Nurul Hasan stays low and looks to guide it past the short third man fielder but he misses.

NOT OUT! Pakistan lose a review! A googly, around middle, turning in late. Nurul Hasan fails to pick the googly and gets rapped on the pads as he fails to work it on the leg side from the back foot. Shadab Khan appeals but the umpire is not interested. Babar Azam opts for a review but the Ball Tracker suggest that the impact is with the umpire's call and the ball would have missed the leg stump.

A googly is not read by Nurul Hasan. He is rapped on the pads, the appeal is made but the finger has stayed down. Shadab Khan has a word with his skipper and Babar Azam takes the referral. Seems to be turning too much. Ball Tracker confirms that it's missing the leg stump.
Flatter ball, around middle. Mahedi Hasan strokes it past Shadab Khan towards mid on and takes a run.
Mahedi Hasan is the new batsman.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Another soft dismissal but this time it is a brilliant catch by Shadab Khan off his own bowling! Tossed up, on a fuller length around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to flick it but he closes the face of the bat too early. He only manages a leading edge that goes to the left of Shadab Khan. He dives in that direction and takes a very good low catch. Bangladesh losing their way out in the middle as another set batsman departs.
Wide! Too wide outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to cut it past point but he fails to get any bat on it.
Flatter ball, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto reaches out to play the cut shot but he misses. Shadab turns to appeal for a catch but later realizes that Rizwan has not gathered the ball.
Shadab Khan to bowl out. 1/20 off his 3 overs so far.
Short of a length, around leg. Najmul Hossain Shanto hops in his crease and just nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single. Just 3 runs and a wicket from the over!
On a length, around middle and leg. Nurul Hasan tucks it to the leg side to get off the mark with a run.
Nurul Hasan walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! A wicket against the run of play and it is a huge one for Pakistan as it is Bangladesh's skipper Mahmudullah who walks back to the hut! Short of a length, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to run it down to third man but is late into his shot and gets a thick outside edge. Mohammad Rizwan behind the sticks takes a very simple catch. Yet another timely breakthrough for Pakistan and the move to bring back a pacer has worked.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around off. Mahmudullah is cramped for room and he blocks it towards backward point.
Good-length ball, outside off. Mahmudullah taps it towards backward point. Shadab Khan dives to his left and stops the ball.
Back of a length, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto hangs back and steers it uppishly towards third man for a run.
Bowling change. Bangladesh have been finding it easy against the spinners so Babar Azam has decided to bring back Haris Rauf.
A half-tracker, just outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto pulls it to wide of long on and takes a single. 6 runs off the over!
A bit quicker and shorter in length, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto guides it to short third man. The fielder there runs to his right and does not concede a run.
Flatter ball, around off. Mahmudullah stays back and guides it to short third man. The batters scamper through for a single.
FOUR! Intent from Bangladesh's skipper! Tossed up, around off. Mahmudullah skips down and smacks it past the bowler for a boundary at long off.
Fuller in length, outside off. Mahmudullah drives hard but Shadab Khan at extra cover dives to his right and stops the ball.
Flatter ball, around middle and leg. Mahmudullah looks to go inside-out but he gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Another short ball, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto pulls it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder and collects a couple of runs to end the over.
Just a tad short, around leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to pull but he misses out on the scoring opportunity as gets it from the inner half of the blade towards short fine leg.
Loopy ball, outside off. Mahmudullah looks for the expansive drive but he only manages an under-edge. The ball ricochets off the keeper's pads and goes towards backward point. A single taken.

Good running! Flatter ball, outside off. Mahmudullah hangs back and cuts it past the point fielder and comes back for the second run. The fielder in the deep runs across and throws it to the keeper but Mahmudullah is well inside the crease.
Tossed up, outside off. Mahmudullah prods and carves it past the extra cover fielder. The fielder at long off runs across and keeps it to two.

Short ball, around off. Najmul Hossain Shanto rocks back and looks to pull but it takes the upper half of the blade. The ball balloons over the non-striker and travels towards long off. The batters cross for a run.

Flatter ball, around off, turning away late. Mahmudullah gets deceived by the late turn and he blocks it off the front foot. At the halfway mark, Bangladesh have recovered to reach 64/3. A distinct improvement from the last match as they were 40/4 after 10.
A bit quicker, around middle and leg. Najmul Hossain Shanto nudges it towards deep square leg and rotates the strike.
Overpitched ball, around off. Mahmudullah turns it to mid-wicket and settles for just one.
Flatter ball, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts it towards sweeper cover and collects a single.

FOUR! Punished by Najmul Hossain Shanto! A half-tracker, outside off. Shanto goes deep in his crease and pulls it in through mid-wicket. The long on fielder rushes across to his left but has no chance of cutting it off.
Flatter ball, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto stays back and guides it towards short fine leg. He wanted a run but is rightly sent back by his skipper.
Mohammad Nawaz is introduced into the attack.
On a length, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto works it to long on and takes a run.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Just a tad short, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto rocks back and pulls it wide of long on. He bisects the fielders in the deep to perfection and collects a boundary.
Flatter ball, outside off. Mahmudullah rocks back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.

NOT OUT! Mahmudullah survives! Flatter ball, on a fuller length, just outside off. Mahmudullah gets down on his knee and looks to paddle scoop it past the short fine leg but he misses and gets hit on his pad. Shadab Khan puts in an appeal and the umpire raises his finger after thinking for a while. Mahmudullah opts for the DRS and the Ball Tracker shows that the impact was well outside off.
Huge shout for an lbw! The finger has gone up and Mahmudullah decides to review it. The impact could be an issue here. It indeed is.
Flighted delivery, around off. Mahmudullah skips down and defends it watchfully in the end.
Mahmudullah walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Afif Hossain has thrown away his wicket and it was a completely needless shot at this point in time. Flatter ball, landing on middle and skidding away after hitting the surface. Hossain gets low and looks to reverse-paddle but he gets the toe-end of the bat. The ball loops up in the air just behind the sticks and Mohammad Rizwan there takes a simple catch. A poor shot selection and a blossoming stand has been nipped in the bud.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Top effort from Shadab Khan but the ball wins! Flatter ball, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto rocks back and cuts it past point. Shadab Khan gives it a chase, puts in a slide but fails to prevent the boundary. 50 up!
Shadab Khan will continue from the opposite end...
A bit quicker, on a length, outside off. Afif Hossain stays back and punches it towards sweeper cover for a run.
A tad short, sliding down leg. Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it towards mid-wicket and collects a single.
Flatter ball, just outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto blocks it off the front foot and wants a single but is sent back by Afif Hossain.
Tossed up, outside off. Afif Hossain comes forward, taps it to backward point and takes off for a single.
Excellent running! Flatter ball, on middle and leg. Afif Hossain turns it to wide long on and scampers back for the second run.
Bowling change. Shoaib Malik returns to bowl after the Powerplay. His first over went for 7 runs. With two left-handers in the middle, Babar Azam is forced to hold back Mohammad Nawaz.
A single to end the over! Just a tad short, outside off. Afif Hossain rocks back and opens the face of his bat to guide it towards deep point.
This is tossed up, around middle. Afif Hossain prods and blocks it watchfully.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Najmul Hossain Shanto turns it towards deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Wide! Shadab errs in line and spills this one down the leg side. Najmul Hossain Shanto misses his nudge. Wide called by the umpire.
Tossed up, down leg. Afif Hossain comes forward and tucks it to the leg side. It's in the gap at mid-wicket and the batters cross for a run.
Another full ball, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto prods and drills it to long on for a run.
Tossed up, around middle and leg. Afif Hossain eases it to long on and collects a single.

FOUR! What a way to end the Powerplay! It's fuller and outside off, there to be hit and Najmul Hossain Shanto presses forward before crunching it through the gap at extra cover for a boundary. Bangladesh are 36/2 after the first 6 overs.
A low full toss around off, Afif strokes it down to mid on where Khushdil Shah dives to his right to stop the racing ball. They take a single.
Almost an 89 mph delivery, short and around off, Afif tries to play the ramp shot but fails to connect.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and hits it with soft hands to mid off. They cross for a sharp run.
Pitches it up and around off, Najmul pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Haris Rauf begins from 'round the wicket and delivers it on a length around off, Shanto plays it down from the crease to point.
Haris Rauf is into the attack.
This one is tossed up very nicely, around off, Afif is forward in defense.
Goes on the back foot to a short delivery and punches it down through mid on for one.
The umpires are having a boundary check! Mohammad Wasim at fine leg has just managed to pull the ball back in play and has saved a couple of runs for his side.

Fortunate! Malik follows the batsman down the leg side with a flatter short ball, Shanto steps back to cut but under-edges it past the stumps and short fine leg. Mohammad Wasim chases and stops it near the fence. It's referred upstairs as the fielder has his one hand very close to the fence while pulling it back but the third umpire reckons that he has done it neatly. Two added to the total.
FOUR! Sweet shot! Flatter one, a slider around middle and leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto sits down on one knee and sweeps it firmly behind square leg for a boundary.
Leans forward to a full ball to smother the spin and defends it down near the pitch.
Flighted and full around off, Shanto is forward as he defends it to the off side.
Shoaib Malik comes to bowl now.
On a length around middle and off, Hossain stays on the back foot and plays it down to cover-point. Not in the gap this time.
FOUR! Fantastic shot! Back of a length, around off and angling away, Afif opens the face at the correct time as he spanks it through the gap at cover-point for a boundary.

WHAT A DELIVERY! Fractionally short and around off, shaping away at 89 mph, there is some extra bounce and Afif attempts to play at it late. But the ball shoots up and beats the edge. A good take by Mohammad Rizwan.
Around off on a fuller length, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it down to mid off and crosses for a run.
Back of a length around off, angling away, Afif uses the angle and pace of the bowler to run it down to third man for one.

On a length and around leg, Afif Hossain works it off his pads to short fine leg and looks for a run. He is sent back as Haris Rauf scores a direct hit at the striker's end. Afif is safely in though. He wants to take a run as the ball has deflected away but his partner is not interested.
Serves it on a length around off, at 89 mph, Afif is a bit early into the shot and plays a mistimed chip shot. It though clears the infield at covers and they pick up a single. 12 from the over.
On a length and around off, Afif is on the back foot as he plays it down to point.

FOUR LEG BYES! Shaheen Afridi needs to get his composure back. Aims for a yorker but once again it's an ill-directed full toss down the leg side. Afif fails to flick but it takes the pads and runs wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
Out comes the physio as Afif Hossain looks in some pain out there in the middle. The physio has a quick check on the batter and he looks good to resume.

OH DEAR! Shaheen Afridi gets carried away with his aggression. Fuller and around off, at 89.9 mph, Afif is forward as he pushes it defensively back to the bowler. Afridi collects the ball, turns and has a needless shy at the striker's end. It hits Afif on the ankle, near the unprotected part and he is down in pain. Shaheen quickly goes and apologizes but it seems the damage is done.

SIX! Very, very nicely done. Shaheen errs in line, deviates down the leg side with a fuller length ball, Afif Hossain picks it off his pads and flicks it nonchalantly over backward square leg for a biggie. He is away in style.
Fullish and on off at 87.9 mph, Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it down to mid on with soft hands and steals a quick run.
Afif Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AT FIRST SLIP! Mohammad Wasim has a wicket as well. He dishes out a length ball outside off at 88 mph, it lands and moves away from the batsman who tries to flash his bat at it. No footwork, poor execution and it's a thick outside edge which is pouched safely by Fakhar Zaman. It's once again a sorry start for Bangladesh.
Commentary.Howout: c Fakhar Zaman b Mohammad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: Good length, on middle, Naim gets behind the line and defends it to mid-wicket.
Fuller in length on off, driven to mid off.
Full and around off, Shanto bunts it down to mid off and scampers across to the other end.

EDGED BUT SAFE! Beautiful delivery from Mohammad Wasim. Some exaggerated away movement after it lands on a length around off, Naim tries to push inside the line but edges it behind. It doesn't carry to the keeper who has dived across to his left. The ball deflects away to point and the batters cross.
On a length around leg, Shanto fails to work it around and is hit on the pads. It rolls to square leg and they cross for a leg bye.
Who will bowl from the other end? Mohammad Wasim it is.
Shaheen tries for a yorker but it's a full toss outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto slices it off the outside edge to third man for a run. A top first over by Afridi.
Najmul Hossain Shanto walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! A corker of a delivery from Shaheen. He hurls in a cracking full delivery on middle to the right-hander, Saif goes nowhere with his footwork. He attempts to bring his bat down in defense but it sticks behind the pads and the ball pings him on the front leg. Shaheen runs in appeal for an lbw but the umpire turns it down. Babar Azam takes the DRS and the UltraEdge first confirms that there is no bat involved. Three reds on the Ball Tracker and Bangladesh lose their first wicket in the very first over of the match.

Review time! Shaheen Afridi has convinced his skipper, Babar Azam to opt for a review! Saif Hassan has been rapped in front and Afridi looks very confident. The Ball Tracker indicates three reds and Saif Hassan is a goner! The on-field decision is overturned!
Shaheen serves a yorker on off, Naim digs it out from the bottom portion of his bat at cover-point. The fielder fumbles and they get a single. Bangladesh are underway.

Not in any control of the shot. Shaheen spears in a full ball on middle, once again Naim is stuck on the crease as he attempts to flick. He closes the face of his blade early and gets it away off the leading edge. It dribbles away to point.
Slightly fuller and around off, Naim shows no footwork as he defends it out to the off side.
Starts off by angling in a length ball on off, Naim stays on the back foot and defends it down on the pitch.

We are all set for the game to begin! The players of Pakistan have made their way out to the middle. Saif Hassan and Mohammad Naim are at the crease. Shaheen Afridi to start with the ball. Here we go...

Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan, says that they would have bowled first anyway and will look to restrict Bangladesh. Tells that both sides struggled with the bat in the first game. He talks about the depth in his batting and appreciates the batting efforts of Fakhar Zaman, Khushdil Shah and Mohammad Nawaz yesterday. Informs that Shaheen Afridi replaces Hasan Ali.

Mahmudullah, the skipper of Bangladesh, says that they will bat first. Adds that it is hard to predict the wicket but it looks like a good one. Tells that in a T20 game you need a good start and they would like to improve in that area. Says that bowlers have been putting in the hard yards but the batting department needs to do well. Informs that they are unchanged going into this game.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Haider Ali, Shoaib Malik, Shadab Khan, Khushdil Shah, Mohammad Nawaz, Shaheen Afridi (In for Hasan Ali), Mohammad Wasim, Haris Rauf.

Bangladesh (Unchanged Playing XI) - Mohammad Naim, Saif Hassan, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Aminul Islam, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman, Mahedi Hasan, Shoriful Islam.
TOSS UPDATE - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of BANGLADESH. They have elected to BAT first.

Pakistan would be quite confident coming into this game but they too have some areas of concern and it was very much visible in their opening game. They seem to have found an able replacement for Shaheen Afridi in Mohammad Wasim who was very clinical, especially with the new ball. Hasan Ali also found his rhythm and set up the game nicely for the visitors. Their middle and lower-middle order batting could prove to be a slight worry for them as they have lacked consistency. Their premier openers in Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan perished cheaply in the first game, however, they would look to make amends in the second T20I and see their team through. Having said that, both sides have all to play for and it promises to be an intriguing battle. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.

Bangladesh fought hard in the first game but they had no answers to Shadab Khan and Mohammad Nawaz's juggernaut right at the fag end and as a result, they suffered a defeat. They are certainly missing the services of their experienced players in Shakib Al Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim but it is a great opportunity for their youngsters to step up and showcase their talent. The batting department is a major concern for the Bangla Tigers and it seems that they rely heavily on their skipper, Mahmudullah. They have bowled well in patches and as a unit, they will have to bring their A-game against a strong Pakistan side.

Pakistan came out victorious in the first game of the three-match T20I series and the series sees a quick turnaround where Bangladesh and Pakistan face off yet again in less than 24 hours. It is a do-or-die match for Bangladesh and they would be keen to put their best foot forward if they are to stay alive in the series. Pakistan would look to seal the series in the second game itself and stop Bangladesh from winning another T20I series at home. On that note, a very warm welcome to the coverage of this game.
....Match Day....
